# identitynow_tag

Manages a tag. Tags are assigned to objects with [identitynow_tagged_object](tagged_object).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "identitynow_tag" "pci" {
  name = "PCI"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name. Tags cannot be renamed, changing this forces a new tag to be created.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `id` (String) Tag ID.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `tag_category_refs` (Attributes List) Objects the tag is assigned to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_category_refs))

<a id="nestedatt--tag_category_refs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tag_category_refs`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Object ID.
- `name` (String) Object name.
- `type` (String) Object type.

## Import

Tags can be imported using their ID:

```shell
terraform import identitynow_tag.example <tag-id>
```
